title: Vertical cylindrical rod
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Begin by drawing a single face and within this face, draw one loop. Inside this loop, draw a circle with its center at coordinates (0.0066, 0.0066) and a radius of 0.0066. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0131 to the entire sketch to adjust the dimensions accordingly. Rotate the scaled sketch using Euler angles of (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) and translate it using a translation vector of (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) to ensure it remains in the original position. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to create a three-dimensional solid body. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. The final dimensions of the vertical cylindrical rod will be a length of 0.013125 units, a width of 0.013125 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0066, 0.0066).circle(0.0066)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylindrical rod
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Scale the sketch for the rectangular cross-section
scaled_sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0066, 0.0066).rect(0.0131, 0.0131)

# Extrude the scaled sketch to create the rectangular cross-section
rect_cross_section = scaled_sketch.extrude(0.01)  # Adjusted extrusion depth for the cross-section

# Combine the cylindrical rod and the rectangular cross-section
r = cylinder.union(rect_cross_section)

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the cylindrical base
cylinder = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0066, 0.0066)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0066)  # Create a circle with the given radius
    .extrude(0.75)  # Extrude the circle to create the cylinder
)

# Create the rectangular top
rect_top = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0066, 0.0066)  # Move to the center of the rectangle
    .rect(0.0131, 0.0131)  # Create a rectangle with the given dimensions
    .extrude(0.01)  # Extrude the rectangle to create the top
)

# Combine the cylinder and the rectangular top
r = cylinder.union(rect_top)

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# Overall dimensions
D = 0.0132      # diameter of the rod (X and Y)
L = 0.7500      # length along Z
hex_flat = 0.0132   # hex width across flats at the bottom
hex_h = 0.020       # small hex section height at the bottom

# Main cylindrical rod
rod = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(D / 2).extrude(L)

# Small hexagonal section at the bottom end
hexnut = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .polygon(6, hex_flat / math.cos(math.pi / 6))
    .extrude(hex_h)
)

# Combine
r = rod.union(hexnut)
